title: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Arthritis
h1: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Arthritis
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric can openers for arthritis, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers for arthritis using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Easy push-down lever, Extra-tall opening for large cans, Opens pop-tops too.
strengths: Push-down lever needs only light downward pressure to engage, no squeezing
Stable countertop base means you only lift the can, not the whole unit
Extra-tall design fits large soup and coffee cans without repositioning
Corded motor has more consistent torque than battery models on tough lids
limitations: Takes up permanent counter space rather than living in a drawer
Requires an open outlet nearby since it's corded
Base is not as non-slip as some newer competitors
features: Built-in knife sharpener on some models

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Single-touch automatic operation, Detachable cutting lever, Nonslip wide base.
strengths: Single-touch start and automatic stop mean no need to hold a button through the cut
Nonslip base stays put with one hand steadying the can
Detachable lever comes off for dishwasher cleaning without fine-motor disassembly
limitations: Bulkier footprint on the counter than the Kitchen Mama's drawer-friendly size
Fewer long-term owner reviews than the two more established competitors

products.name: Black+Decker Spacemaker EC600 Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Mounts under a cabinet, One-touch lever operation, Frees up counter space.
strengths: Mounting it under a cabinet means never lifting or moving the opener itself
One-touch lever needs only light pressure, same low-force principle as the countertop models
Keeps the counter clear, useful if counter space itself is limited for maneuvering cans
limitations: Installation requires mounting screws, which is a one-time task someone else may need to help with
Fixed height under the cabinet may not suit every user's reach
Smallest owner base of the four picks here, so less long-term reliability data

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
